name: in-field-button
description: A button embedded inside a field's input area, such as a clear or disclosure action.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Filled, rounded square that holds the icon and receives the pointer and focus.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Glyph that says what the button does (clear, add, dash, chevron, calendar).

anatomyReview.notes: Owner decision D3 (2026-11-19): a component that hosts nest as the part in-field-button. Figma Subcomponents page (.In-field button: Type, Quiet, size, state), RSP inputButton style, SWC swc-infield-button. The five stacked S1 records stay active with no part (decision D4b, bead 5m92.5.3.3). Options and states are not modelled yet.
